items.title: User Access Management
items.description: All user accounts must be approved before creation. Access rights must be reviewed quarterly and revoked upon termination.

items.title: Privileged Access Control
items.description: Privileged accounts must be limited, monitored, and reviewed monthly. Multi-factor authentication is required for all admin access.

items.title: Identity Lifecycle Management
items.description: User identities must be uniquely assigned and managed throughout their lifecycle including onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.

items.title: Data Encryption
items.description: All sensitive data must be encrypted at rest and in transit using strong cryptographic standards such as AES-256 and TLS 1.2 or higher.

items.title: Key Management
items.description: Encryption keys must be securely generated, stored, rotated, and revoked according to defined key management procedures.

items.title: Incident Response Management
items.description: Security incidents must be identified, reported, and responded to within defined SLAs. Incident response procedures must be documented.

items.title: Incident Logging and Tracking
items.description: All security incidents must be logged, tracked, and analyzed to identify root causes and improve response processes.

items.title: Logging and Monitoring
items.description: System logs must be collected, monitored, and retained for at least 90 days to detect and investigate suspicious activities.

items.title: SIEM Integration
items.description: All critical systems must send logs to a centralized SIEM platform for correlation and threat detection.

items.title: Backup Management
items.description: Backups must be performed daily and stored securely. Backup restoration must be tested periodically.

items.title: Disaster Recovery
items.description: Disaster recovery plans must be documented and tested annually to ensure system availability during disruptions.

items.title: Network Security
items.description: Firewalls and intrusion detection systems must be deployed to protect internal networks from unauthorized access.

items.title: Secure Configuration
items.description: All systems must follow secure configuration baselines and unnecessary services must be disabled.

items.title: Vulnerability Management
items.description: Systems must be scanned regularly for vulnerabilities and patches must be applied within defined timelines.

items.title: Patch Management
items.description: Critical patches must be applied within 7 days and high-risk vulnerabilities must be prioritized.
